glyph_geometry: Common row cap/ascender height from H/h/0 and punctuation slash. Source-relative small marks, x-height and descenders retained; baseline is the reference character's exclusive stroke bottom.
limitations: All splits reuse the same 67 glyph templates from 4 source image(s).
Disjoint scene hashes and random seeds do not create independent font or drawing samples.
Synthetic metrics cannot establish performance on unseen real CAD drawings.
Only five supplied punctuation marks; no Korean or other fonts are represented.
Demo image also reuses the training glyph templates.
